company.description:
Entlaqa provides its customers with innovative solutions focused to increase the engagement of their External Customers, or Internal Customers (Employees).

The company uses the latest technologies in VR to create virtual simulations in Business, Imagine a virtual bank where virtual customers are meeting customer service agents every day to challenge them with different business cases.

It was founded in 2013 and based in Gîza, Al Jizah, Egypt.
